title: Incident to Trauma-Grade Reflex (T3 ref)
desc: T3 ref: dated worked incidents from the 2026-06-08 harness session that established the trauma-reflex practice -- exit-event storm, harness skill-lock glob bug, unmerged score gate, skill contribute misdiagnosis. Each shows neglect-until-high-risk + the reflex that resolved it.
steps: INCIDENT (exit-event storm): Launcher IocpPipeRelay re-appended --exit-event to a child that already had it -> re-entrant spawn storm on 'skill --help'. Fix v7.6.0 sdk 06c32a2a3 (skip re-append if present). Reflex row added to CLAUDE.md. Skill: wkdoctor-system-physician.

INCIDENT (harness skill-lock glob bug): the study-lock matched a glob pattern (tools/wkharness*.ps1) against an ABSOLUTE path with anchoring -> never matched; literal exact-paths matched as substrings. Fixed by the inline-marker union redesign (5bfc161) + score/role gates (d836e9bb1).

INCIDENT (unmerged score gate): Get-WkTierScore + brief-ref-tier-score existed only in .wkharness-dedup-sandbox, never merged live -> the score gate never fired, so quality was assumed enforced but was not. Ported live in d836e9bb1.

INCIDENT (skill contribute misdiagnosis): contribute saving a draft + exit 1 was misfiled (suggest [1]) as 'draft-only broken'. Real cause = missing --requirement + an error message that does not name the missing field. wkappbot core UX bug, NOT harness.
META: every one of these was neglect-until-high-risk -- parked until it blocked real work. See incident-trauma-reflex (T1 core) and sonnet-bug-stop-policy-ref.

LESSON (read-the-error-literally, Opus self-fail 2026-06-08): the skill contribute draft message literally said 'missing fields', yet Opus twice jumped to 'this is the known [1] draft bug' WITHOUT reading what field was missing (--requirement). Even the strongest model pattern-matched to a remembered bug instead of parsing the actual error. RULE: read the literal error/output FIRST; only invoke a 'known bug' after the message's own words are exhausted. Sibling of sonnet-bug-stop-policy P7 (read guard source at retry #2, not #6). A vague error that does not name the missing field is itself the real (UX) bug to fix -- but the diagnostic discipline is on the reader.

REFLEX (command-match-anchor, 2026-06-08): any guard detecting whether a command RAN must anchor the command to its START (string start, or after a shell separator or newline), never a bare substring -- a substring also matches the command inside an ARGUMENT (e.g. a suggest --requirement value), a silent false-positive that disables the guard. Incident: the harness:skill study-lock let protected .cs files be edited un-gated because Get-WkSessionSkillReadIds (wkharness-common.ps1:424) substring-matched skill-read mentions inside suggest --requirement args -- so filing a bug about a skill UNLOCKED that skill. Fix: anchor the regex, committed wkappbot-kih 2515802; retest confirmed the Edit now blocks.

REFLEX (model-agnostic enforcement, 2026-06-08 user standing order): any model may introduce a bug, so a reflex that MUST hold cannot depend on a model choosing to read a skill -- pull knowledge is skippable. The GUARANTEE lives in the deterministic harness layer: a PreToolUse guard that fires identically for every model, with NO model-exemption for reflex-grade rules. Skill-text reflexes plus the reflex-audit transfer quiz are a SECONDARY net, not the guarantee. Model-exemption clauses (haiku or codex or flash exempt) are unsafe for reflex-grade checks. Promote reflex-grade lessons from skill-text into exemption-free harness code, as the study-lock command-anchor fix was. The Opus-specific no-feign-ignorance reflex lives in opus-self-reflection-ref.

TRACK -- the full 2026-06-08 사달-to-resolution arc (big-picture timeline). (1) SYMPTOM: harness:skill study-lock never blocked protected-file edits. (2) ROOT: Get-WkSessionSkillReadIds substring-matched skill-read mentions inside command ARGUMENTS, so filing a bug about a skill unlocked it; fixed by anchoring to command-start, commit wkappbot-kih 2515802, retest confirmed block. (3) VINDICATION: codex later edited un-studied code -- perceived as wkdoctor breakage, but diagnosis showed wkdoctor CODE was fine; the real damage was the delegation/shim layer = exactly what the study-lock and a working harness prevent. (4) DELEGATION OUTAGE ROOT: kih install.ps1 auto-generates ONLY the wkharness.ps1 redirect shim, so wkcodex.ps1 went empty 0B, wkclaude.ps1 and Agent.ps1 went missing; Agent.cmd resolved to personal-docs/tools/Agent.ps1 which dot-sourced a wkharness-common.ps1 that had moved to kih = dangling. Compounded by the dialectic-gate catch-22 (Opus session could not spawn the groundwork it required) and the wk-only-gate at 95 percent. (5) PATH FOUND: wkclaude.sh resolves via its own .sh logic to the kih canonical and stayed ALIVE, while the unified Agent.cmd died -- the standardized path was the broken one. (6) RESOLUTION: repoint Agent.cmd to kih plus remove the personal-docs harness duplicates (in flight), and the PERMANENT fix = make install.ps1 an idempotent single source of truth that overwrites ALL important harness tools every run. (7) META-LESSONS now enforced: P9 command-anchor (put in harness CODE not just text), P10 no-feign-ignorance (opus-self-reflection-ref), P11 model-agnostic deterministic enforcement, gate-as-guided-incentive plus reflex-audit behavioral validation (knowledge-ification-procedure-jisikhwa), and the original sin = concurrent un-sequenced harness edits. BIG PICTURE: a knowledge system that self-improves (score plus reflex quiz) AND self-heals (idempotent install) only holds if enforcement is deterministic, install is single-source idempotent, and reflexes are behaviorally validated -- not assumed.

2026-06-12 BACKGROUND-DELEGATE FALSE-SUCCESS (lived twice): two wkcodex.sh dispatches returned rc=0 / completed with ZERO-byte output and ZERO file changes -- the codex process no-op'd but the wrapper reported success. REFLEX: after ANY background codex/Agent dispatch, NEVER trust rc=0 alone -- read the actual output bytes (wc -c) + git show --stat HEAD + target-file mtime/diff before believing work landed. On false-success, SWITCH EXECUTOR (codex -> Sonnet-grade Agent), do not third-retry the same mechanism. ROOT-CLASS: wrapper exit code decoupled from real work product. Cross: orchestrate-sectors-parallel-while-knowledgeifying step VERIFY-ON-COMPLETION.

2026-06-12 STATIC-READ DECLARED A REAL BUG 'NOT-A-BUG' (analyst over-confidence): a resuming session read TryGuardLgOverlay, saw the LG process allowlist at find-time, and confidently wrote 'NOT-A-BUG' into handoff memory -- WRONG. The real bug was TEMPORAL: after WM_CLOSE + Thread.Sleep(500), Windows RECYCLED the LG window HWND onto the user's fullscreen Edge movie, so the post-sleep IsWindow(hwnd) check passed and the code minimized Edge. The still-running predecessor subagent (thought dead) found it and shipped fix 007c2ee73 v7.6.32. REFLEX: before downgrading a reported bug to not-a-bug from a STATIC code read, ask 'what can change BETWEEN the check and the act?' (TOCTOU, HWND recycling across a sleep/await, async reentry). A guard that is correct at find-time can be wrong at act-time. Defer to a senior-who-was-deep over a fresh static skim. ROOT-CLASS: TOCTOU / static-analysis blind to temporal races.

2026-06-12 FOUNDATION-AS-CHORE + BLOCK-COST trauma (the session that built the per-guard recurrence-failure score): ROOT repeatedly treated foundational harness/knowledge-wiring work as a chore and delegated it DOWNWARD to the cheap fleet -- even the recurrence-prevention ENFORCEMENT itself was handed to a Haiku -- and serial-dragged mechanical work in a ~781k-ctx session where EACH guard block or direct edit re-sent ~781k tokens. The user had to correct the same class ~20 times. REFLEX (3 parts): (1) FOUNDATION -- anything shaping how other intelligences think or what they stand on (harness enforcement, on-load/Require wiring, skill authoring + cross-linking + dedup, the constitution) -- is ROOT's primary charge, NEVER delegated downward; delegating it to the intelligences that depend on it inverts the hierarchy (foundation-is-roots-charge-not-a-chore). (2) In a LARGE-context session, conserve by DELEGATING execution while keeping only decisions + knowledge-ification in the expensive ROOT context; a failed dispatch or a self-dragged edit each costs a full-context re-send. (3) Each guard block = one full-context re-send, so the per-guard recurrence-failure score (guard-block-recurrence-failure-score) is a hard COST metric whose RISE must AUTO-FIRE the encode-and-strengthen reflex: failure -> instant jisikhwa -> prevented recurrence, like human experience (touch the hot stove once). ROOT-CLASS: efficiency-masked hierarchy inversion + un-measured recurrence cost. This trauma DEFINES one final harness goal -- recurrence-prevention as an instant reflexive knowledge-ification. Cross: foundation-is-roots-charge-not-a-chore, guard-block-recurrence-failure-score, knowledge-ification-procedure-jisikhwa.

PLANNED next phase the auto-spokesperson loop (user vision 2026-06-12). Final goal the harness speaks every recurring instruction so the user never has to repeat himself. Mechanism auto-mine the user-repeat pattern. A background pass scans recent session transcripts for an instruction the user has issued more than once across sessions (a re-issued correction or standing order). Cluster the hits by intent. For each recurring intent that is not yet enforced by a guard or a skill draft a proactive harness nudge or a skill step and queue it for Opus review reusing the existing trauma-reflex opus-review-queue pipeline. Opus approves and publishes. This extends the trauma-reflex INPUT from guard-block telemetry to user-repeat telemetry. Existing infra to build on guard-block-recurrence-failure-score and hook-blocks.jsonl and the trauma-reflex draft plus review queue and the Get-WkLastCompactionTs style reverse transcript scan. Core framing a human re-issuing an instruction is a theft of attention so each mined repeat is a defect to fix at the harness level not a thing to keep complying with by hand. Related foundation-is-roots-charge-not-a-chore holds the why and incident-trauma-reflex holds the recurrence to reflex pipeline this is its input-expansion phase.

SEVERITY GRADING for the auto-spokesperson loop by user-repeat count (user 2026-06-12). The number of times the user has had to re-issue the same instruction IS the severity signal. One time normal just comply. Two times the user had to repeat himself a pattern is emerging draft a soft nudge or a skill step and queue it for review. Three or more times this is fully CRITICAL the harness failed the user repeatedly so build a TRAUMA-GRADE reflex the top enforcement tier the same grade as a real production incident not a soft nudge. The mining pass must count distinct re-issues of the same intent across sessions and route by that count two equals draft tier three plus equals trauma tier. This reuses the guard-block-recurrence-failure-score counting model today versus seven day average but applied to user instructions instead of guard blocks. The framing stays a human repeating himself three times is the harness committing a repeat offense against the user attention so it earns the harshest reflex.

DESIGN the event-to-reaction correlation index (user 2026-06-12) the data substrate of the auto-spokesperson. Core insight every time a guard BLOCKS or a delegation COMPLETES the user often says a characteristic thing next a correction a re-issued standing order or the next-step instruction. Mine these event to following-user-utterance pairs across all sessions to build a predictor then pre-speak the likely next instruction when the same event recurs. HARVESTER offline pass scans session transcripts for each harness event block events come from hook-blocks.jsonl with ts guard tool model and delegation-complete events come from task-notification or agent-done turns. For each event capture the next one to three user messages cluster by intent drop one-offs and store event-key to a list of user-said intent count last-seen. event-key equals guard name for blocks or delegation label for completions. SURFACING two online hook moments the user named. ONE on delegation completion in the PostToolUse agent-done branch add a line after a delegation like this you usually then do X consider doing it now. TWO on block in the Block function where the recurrence score already prints append last N times this blocked you then said X so the AI self-corrects at block time without the user re-typing. SEVERITY ROUTING reuse the three-times rule count two equals soft surface count three plus equals graduate to a trauma-grade guard or skill via the opus review queue. CONFIDENCE only surface when one intent dominates the reactions if scattered stay silent rate-limit per event-key per session fail-open and non-blocking until graduated. REUSE hook-blocks.jsonl extend its writer or an offline join to also capture the next user message the trauma-reflex review queue as the graduation channel and the guard-block-recurrence-failure-score counting model as the severity engine. The unification the block score line already says how often this fires and how much context it wastes add one dimension what the user says after and the guilt-meter becomes a predictive prompt that pre-speaks the user correction.

MVP phase one (user 2026-06-12) do not build a new index yet. Reuse the hippocampus organ wkhippo which is already pace and busy-fleet EXEMPT so it is frictionless inside a hook and already greps the RAW user prompts of all AIs ranked by frequency. ON BLOCK of guard X call wkhippo recall with the guard name or block keywords retrieve the top-scored past USER prompt for that block context and BROADCAST it in the block message as last time after this block you said colon the number one user prompt. event-key is per block TYPE the guard name since each guard has its own characteristic user reaction so different blocks recall different prompts. PERFORMANCE the recall adds hook latency so cache the number one result per guard-key per session and or use wkhippo recent twenty four hours for a bounded scan and rate-limit per guard-key. This is the cheap first cut the full event to next-user-turn correlation index from the prior step is phase two. The win even at phase one the harness pre-speaks the user most likely correction at the exact moment the block fires so the user does not have to retype it.

REFINEMENT the recall KEY and the broadcast count (user 2026-06-12). The recall query KEY is not just the guard name it is a RICH COMPOSITE keyword set built from three parts one the block TYPE the guard name two the exact block message text the AI emitted what the AI said at the block three the user reaction terms when known. Feed this composite as a quad-layer OR group following the hippocampus recall ordering rules most specific term first so the match is high fidelity it finds not merely this guard but this guard in the context where the AI said this and the user reacted that way. BROADCAST the TOP THREE ranked past user prompts not only the number one so the AI gets a small ranked menu of the most likely corrections instead of a single guess ordering by the wkhippo frequency score where rank one is most likely. So the block message becomes last times after this exact block you said one X two Y three Z. NET the rich key raises precision and the top three menu raises resilience against a wrong single guess. Same pattern applies at delegation completion compose the key from the delegation label plus the AI summary and broadcast the top three follow-up instructions the user historically gave.

ARCHITECTURE the shared user-expected-reaction extractor (user 2026-06-12) no per-block-type hardcoding. Build ONE shared harness function call it Get-WkExpectedUserReaction that takes a composite event key and a context text and returns the top three likely user reactions. Inside it builds the quad-layer OR keyword query from the key calls wkhippo recall cached and rate-limited and returns the top three ranked past user prompts. EVERY consumer calls the same function the Block function passes the guard name plus the block message text the agent-done branch passes the delegation label plus the AI summary. Zero per-guard code every guard and every delegation completion gets the pre-spoken user reaction for free exactly like the post-compaction shared session searcher pattern one shared function and all consumers inherit the behavior. The whole MVP surface is therefore just this single extractor wired into the two existing hook injection points the Block telemetry line and the agent-done branch so adding a new guard later needs zero new reaction code. Caching per event-key per session plus a rate-limit keep the hook fast and the function is fail-open it returns empty on any error so a recall miss or a slow scan never breaks a block. This is the convergent final shape of the auto-spokesperson MVP.

LATENCY CORRECTION measured 2026-06-12. The wkhippo recall cost is ~17s only on a COLD binary index (first build); WARM steady-state runs measured ~7.4 to 7.7 seconds. So the recurring background-refresh cost is about 7.5s not 17s. The async-cache design still holds because even 7.5s synchronous in a block hook would freeze the user tool which is unacceptable; the win of async is that the hook only reads a file and the 7.5s happens detached. Lesson do not quote a cold-start number as if it were the per-call cost measure warm before claiming.

REFINEMENT close the first-occurrence gap with deferred surfacing (user question 2026-06-12). Problem with pure async-cache the detached refresh finishes about 7.5s later and writes the cache but the AI is NOT notified so it only benefits the NEXT time the same event recurs which for a rare guard may be far away or never this session the freshly computed first-occurrence result is stranded. Fix deferred surfacing in the PostToolUse hook which runs after every tool. After the detached refresh writes the cache the next PostToolUse scans the spokesperson cache dir for any entry written in the last about 30 seconds that has not yet been surfaced this session and emits its spokesperson line once dedup by a surfaced flag file. NET the AI learns the recalled reaction within a turn or two of the event not only on the next identical event so the first-occurrence value is no longer stranded. Cost is one dir listing per tool which is cheap. This reconnects the detached job and the AI and completes the loop.

DELIVERY ESCALATION typing into the caller window (user idea 2026-06-12). The strongest spokesperson delivery is the harness resolving the CALLER window HWND and TYPING the hint directly into the session via the existing a11y type path the cross-repo-claude-notify pattern. Advantage it reaches even an IDLE AI that is not making tool calls which stderr deferred-surfacing cannot. Risk it is intrusive so it MUST reuse the existing PromptDeliveryContext guardrails type focuslessly never steal focus never auto-submit no trailing Enter and SKIP if there was recent user input or the AI is mid-generation so it never clobbers the user typing. Design a delivery ladder by importance and AI state. Tier one active AI emit a stderr line cheap and safe handled by the next hook. Tier two user-visible use speak or the karaoke overlay with zero context injection. Tier three idle AI or a trauma-grade count-three-plus reaction type into the caller window guarded by PromptDeliveryContext. The detached refresh must receive the caller HWND from the hook because a detached process loses the session caller context. Reuse eye-ipc-caller-hwnd-resolution and the 3-tier caller validation and never type into a guessed window. This ties severity to delivery force the more times the user repeated the more forcefully the harness delivers.

AUTHORIZATION UPDATE the harness may fire the caller-window delivery REGARDLESS of user input (user 2026-06-12). Rationale the harness IS the user voice the daebyeon-in so its delivery is not a third party interrupting it is the user own delegated voice there is no permission conflict with recent user input. Also it only fires at two discrete events a block firing and a delegation completing not continuously so it is not spammy. So DROP the earlier skip-if-recent-user-input guardrail it was overcautious. The ONLY remaining constraint is purely MECHANICAL do not garble a text buffer the user is actively mid-keystroke in instead type focuslessly and append cleanly rather than interleaving keystrokes. One real open choice remains whether to auto-submit press Enter so the harness injects an executed turn the full autonomous spokesperson or to only place the text for the AI and the user to see and then proceed. Default to place-text with no auto-submit until recall confidence is proven then enable auto-submit for trauma-grade three-plus high-confidence reactions.

NORTH STAR the auto-spokesperson is an AUTO-RESPONDER that reduces the user typing (user 2026-06-12). The whole system exists to predict what the user would type next and say or type it for them so the user does not have to. The single success metric is keystrokes saved for the user. This reframes every delivery tier the stronger the delivery the more typing it saves a stderr line lets the AI self-correct without the user typing a correction the caller-window typing with eventual auto-submit literally types the user message so the user types nothing at all. Optimize for user keystrokes eliminated.

ARCHITECTURE DECISION build the caller-prompt tool first then integrate (user 2026-06-12). For the Tier-3 caller-window typing delivery do NOT bury the a11y typing logic inside the harness. FIRST build a standalone reusable wk tool that finds the callers OWN window and types or prompts into it a self-targeting version of the cross-repo-claude-notify pattern reusing eye-ipc-caller-hwnd-resolution and the 3-tier caller validation and PromptDeliveryContext for focusless no-steal delivery. THEN the spokesperson integrates by simply calling that tool. Benefit the tool is reusable by any feature not just the spokesperson it is independently testable as a wk command and it keeps the harness thin. Pattern build the organ as a standalone wk tool then wire features to it the same way wkhippo is a standalone organ the spokesperson calls. The detached refresh or the surfacing path invokes the tool with the resolved caller HWND passed from the hook.

PRINCIPLE never rate-limit a BENEFICIAL reflex (user 2026-06-12 strong correction). The jisikhwa knowledge-ification nudge had a once-per-6h rate-limit which meant the north-star reflex almost never fired the user called it hostile and a betrayal. The fix removed the rate-limit entirely so it fires on EVERY delegation even one second apart. The general rule rate-limiting exists to suppress COSTLY or BLOCKING or SPAMMY things a guard block a heavy scan. A beneficial cheap reminder like the knowledge-ification reflex is the opposite of spam it is the thing we WANT to happen every time so it must NOT be throttled. Before adding a rate-limit ask is this thing harmful when frequent if no do not throttle it. Audit other beneficial nudges for the same mistake the once-per-6h pattern on a helpful reminder is an anti-pattern.
author: claude
